dct_description_sm: The purpose of this research is to test various hypotheses relating to the Snow-Shrub Feedback Hypothesis, with emphases on investigating whether annual nitrogen uptake by shrubs will be enhanced with deeper snow cover, thus promoting their expansion across the Arctic. This research will bring improved understanding of the influences of winter biogeochemical processes on summer plant growth, the response of vegetation to differences between ecosystem types and the consequence of shrub expansion for biogeochemical cycling of carbon and nitrogen in the Arctic.
dct_title_s: An Investigation of Mechanisms Driving Shrub Expansion in the low Arctic: Snow and Litter feedbacks
